title: SSRF to Internal API
description: Single Linux machine: SSRF on book cover preview → port scan internal API (5000) → API endpoint leaks creds → dev user → git log → prod creds → sudo GitPython CVE-2022-24439 → root.
introduction: This scenario teaches SSRF to reach internal services: use URL parameters to probe localhost, discover hidden APIs, and chain to privesc. Common web-app pattern for OSCP.
mental_model: SSRF = server fetches URLs you control. Probe 127.0.0.1:5000, 3000, etc. Internal APIs often lack auth. Git history and sudo -l reveal privesc paths.
key_principles: SSRF: inject URL param to fetch internal endpoints
git log -p reveals committed secrets in history
Internal API often has weaker auth than public app
